claims.text: The paper integrates a language model (LM) with cross-lingual word embedding to improve context-aware word-by-word translation.
The use of a language model assists in making context-aware lexical choices during translation, enhancing the overall translation quality.
The proposed methods, including the LM and denoising autoencoder, outperform existing unsupervised neural translation systems without requiring back-translation.
